sources.entry: litestar - Production-ready, capable and extensible ASGI web framework.

summary.one_liner: Litestar is an opinionated, production-oriented ASGI web framework for building APIs, with built-in data validation, dependency injection, ORM integration, guards, middleware, and OpenAPI generation.
summary.what_it_does: Litestar provides class-based and function-based route handlers for building ASGI APIs. It validates, serializes, and deserializes data using msgspec and supports dataclasses, TypedDict, msgspec, pydantic v1 and v2, and attrs types. It generates OpenAPI 3.1 schemas and serves interactive docs through Scalar, Redoc, Stoplight Elements, and Swagger-UI. Dependency injection, layered middleware, route guards for authorization, and life cycle hooks are built in, along with a plugin system, DTOs, and a SQLAlchemy integration. The README also describes RFC 9457 "Problem Detail" error responses and Trio support via AnyIO.
use_cases: validating request data with type hints
integrating SQLAlchemy models with API endpoints
starting a new async web service or proof of concept
how_to_run: pip install 'litestar[standard]'  (adds the CLI and uvicorn server)
Create app.py with a Litestar app and a @get route handler
notable: Typed-first design: missing return type annotations raise an error, and types drive validation and OpenAPI generation
Layered guards, middleware, and dependency injection that can be declared at app, router, or controller level
Mixes pydantic v1 and v2 models within the same application
Ships with four API documentation UIs enabled by default
Reference fullstack application (litestar-fullstack) demonstrates a complete app
caveats: The README does not state a license or platform limits beyond the Python/ASGI context
Opinionated design: the README describes it as opinionated, which may constrain some architectures
Full feature set (CLI, server) requires the optional 'standard' extra install
